summary: MiniMax-H3-Image, the 6-step image build of H3: trained on its six sampling noise levels over Ostris's de-distillation adapter.
notes: The model has one output head per sampling step on its own 6-step grid: sample at 6 steps, simple scheduler, CFG 1 (ComfyUI's template). Other step counts or schedulers blend heads it wasn't distilled for.
Training draws only those six noise levels, each through its own head (Objective → timesteps “scheduler”, simple, 6); a shift has no meaning here.
It's step- and guidance-distilled, so it trains over Ostris's de-distillation adapter (Training only): on while training, never in samples or the saved LoRA.
It's tuned for about 2048×2048 pixels of area and up; lower resolutions show more artifacts, so samples are 2048².
One image per step: the model takes batch size 1. Use gradient accumulation for a bigger batch.
The text encoder is the MiniMax H3 one (a 32B vision-language model): captions are encoded once and cached. An H3 install's copy is reused.
Memory settings are the H3 video ones (same DiT without the audio stream): the int8 build mostly stays in VRAM.

Learning rates measured here (the recipe leaves it to you): a 37-picture face set barely learned at 1e-4 and looked like the person at 1e-3 over about 2000 steps, with gradient accumulation 4, spread noise levels and a low-noise lean of 1.5. An 8-picture style overcooked at 5e-4 and up (blotchy texture, the dataset's characters leaking in) and stayed clean at 2e-4 for 750 to 1000 steps.
